'''Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratory''' was a subsidiary company of [[Sienar Design Systems/Legends|Sienar Design Systems]] and [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]], operating under the successful [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] during the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The research delved into by the company was closely monitored by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], and they were responsible for several prominent developments in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] technology at the time. One of the company's most notorious projects was the development of the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']]. The craft was an advanced ship equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking technology]] and used by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratories was credited with some of the earliest developments concerned with harnessing the power of contained [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]]. This research was eventually implemented in the development of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], proving incredibly effective in powering the immense station's power core. It also was responsible for designing the various models of the [[Advanced Project ship]] and the first mass-produced [[Twin Ion Engine starfighter]]. The laboratory also developed the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

The laboratory was formed by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] some time before [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. In its early years, it was responsible for producing custom products for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and other bodies.
